req.title: Create requires title
req.statement: The system shall render 'Title is required.' when POST /create omits the title field.

doc.reasoning: The violation is test[4] (test_create_unauthenticated_redirects_to_login) which has kind='negative' but heuristic='STC'. The rule requires that negative tests do not use STC heuristic. Fix: change heuristic from 'STC' to 'NEG' for that test, since it is testing a negative/error pathway (unauthenticated access is rejected). All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_create_with_valid_title_succeeds
preconditions: App initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
Database seeded with fixture user id=1 (username='test', password='test')
User is logged in via POST /auth/login
actions: POST /create with title='My Post Title', body='Some body text'
expected: POST /create returns HTTP 302 redirect (success path, no validation error)
Body does NOT contain 'Title is required.'
trace: R-FLASKR-016: when title IS provided, no error should appear; redirect confirms success
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
assert r.status_code == 302
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'My Post Title', 'body': 'Some body text'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
assert b'Title is required.' not in r.data
